## What's changed

- Fixed local-library playback in the native Apple TV player by delivering converted and repackaged media as standards-compliant HLS instead of an unknown-length progressive stream.
- Serves HLS media segments with content lengths and byte-range support expected by AVPlayer.
- Keeps compatible MP4 files on the existing direct-play path and preserves audio-only, video-only, and full-transcode decisions when HLS packaging is required.
- Leaves Steam and retro players on their existing playback paths because the new HLS mode is enabled only when a player explicitly requests it.
